reason: My Notes app and Google Docs already sync between my phone and the library laptop, and they're free. I'd maybe poke at the free tier out of curiosity, but I'm not paying $6 a month on a stipend to rebuild what already works.
objection: Moving years of notes into a new app that could shut down or change its pricing next year, just so a workout shows up on a calendar I don't really need it on.
would_change_my_mind: If it could import all my Apple Notes and Google Docs in one tap and export them back out just as easily, and the free tier was enough that I'd only pay once I was already hooked.
